title: Jurisdiction of District Commission Based on Territorial Limits

content.scenario: A consumer, Karan, purchases a product from a company that has a branch office in Delhi. Karan resides in Gurgaon. He wants to file a complaint against the company in the District Commission.
content.outcome: Karan can file his complaint in the District Commission within the local limits of whose jurisdiction the company has a branch office, which is Delhi, or where Karan resides, which is Gurgaon.

user_queries: Where can I file a complaint against a company with a branch office in another city?
Can I file a complaint in the District Commission where I reside?
What are the territorial limits for filing a complaint in the District Commission?
